title: Closure under matching partners
statement: Let $q$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let a perfect matching be given in the complete multipartite graph with $q$ parts of size $k$, and let $R$ be a set of vertices. The set $R$ is closed under matching partners if the partner of every vertex in $R$ also belongs to $R$.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect matching in the complete multipartite graph with q parts of size k
A finite set R of vertices
